Lines beside the two floats are shortened on both sides, and lines below the left float widen to the left edge while the right float still stands. Once both floats end, the text takes the full width of the page again as it did before, one two three four five six seven eight nine ten.

A second paragraph keeps avoiding the right float until it ends, then spans the whole line like any ordinary block of running text would do.

A box that establishes its own formatting context sits beside the floats, narrowed by taffy, and its lines are not shortened again.
